exercises.q: 地图上「上方」通常表示哪个方向？
exercises.explain: 上北下南左西右东——地图的铁口诀。

exercises.q: 你面向北站着，右手边是？

指南针靠地磁指向南北，是辨方向的祖师爷。

lab.code:
# 地图方位探索台
heading = 90   # 行进方向（度）

hide()
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
go_to(0, -100)
go_to(0, 100)
pen_up()
pen_color("red")
pen_down()
go_to(-100, 0)
go_to(100, 0)
pen_up()
write("北 N", -12, 118, "blue", 13)
write("南 S", -12, -122, "blue", 12)
write("西 W", -128, -8, "red", 12)
write("东 E", 112, -8, "red", 12)
x = 130 * cos(heading)
y = 130 * sin(heading)
pen_color("green")
pen_down()
go_to(0, 0)
go_to(x, y)
pen_up()
dir = "东"
if heading == 0:
    dir = "北"
if heading == 180:
    dir = "南"
if heading == 270:
    dir = "西"
if heading > 0:
    if heading < 90:
        dir = "东北"
if heading > 90:
    if heading < 180:
        dir = "东南"
if heading > 180:
    if heading < 270:
        dir = "西南"
if heading > 270:
    dir = "西北"
write("朝 " + heading + "° 走 = " + dir + "方向", -190, 140, "green", 13)
write("上北下南，左西右东", -190, 112, "orange", 10)
